title: Leo's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Leo, the perfect holiday photo can take a while. They just wanted to be in it with you. Keep the blurry one where you're both laughing. That's the real one.

title: Virgo's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Virgo, fixing the tree at midnight is very you. That crooked star might be the one they hung, though. Leave it. Some things are perfect because they're crooked.

title: Libra's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Two families, one night, and you said yes to both. Libra, you can't please everyone at once. Choose one, say so kindly and plan the other for another day.

title: Scorpio's holiday blind spot
old_caption: Scorpio, not every gift tag is a clue. Sometimes a mug really is just a mug. If you're wondering what something meant, ask them. Don't try to decode it.

title: Sagittarius' holiday blind spot
old_caption: Sagittarius, your holiday trip isn't the problem. Telling them the night before is. Share your dates early because they care where you'll be. And send a postcard.

title: Capricorn's holiday blind spot
old_caption: "Just one email" can eat a whole holiday, Capricorn. The work will still be there tomorrow. They miss you, so close the laptop and play the game.

title: Aquarius' holiday blind spot
old_caption: Going quiet at a big family dinner doesn't make you weird, Aquarius. You're watching. When you're ready, pick one person and ask one question. It opens the whole room.

title: Pisces' holiday blind spot
old_caption: Pisces, you remembered everyone this year, even the neighbour's cat. What's on your list? Your wishes count too, so ask for the hug.

title: Libra: how you love in winter
old_caption: Libra, you love by making everything lovely: the lights, the mugs, the whole room. It's sweet. Just remember the person came for you, not the decor. You are the cozy part.

title: Libra: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Three invites, one Saturday, three yeses. Saying no to a party isn't letting anyone down, it's saving a yes for yourself. One plan is plenty this month.
